result:
Round 478 passes. The 10 acceptance rows I could run here all passed, including the real-browser ones. The full verify, code review and publish belong to the root gate, and I did not run them.

- **Scope:** exactly the 16 granted paths changed, with no changes under `app/**`.
- **Claims script:** my own run gives `unexpected=0`, `FAILS 0`, and all status lines "Completed (C round 478 PASS)".
- **Checkers can fail:** on a copy of the tree, three deliberate mistakes each turned a checker red. These were teal brand in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, a teal rgba back in the awwwards file, and a deleted residual line in the WCAG audit. The real tree was untouched and is green again.
- **Token values in Chromium:** brand, brand-hover, background, surface, foreground and muted match the docs at 1440×900 and 1280×720.
- **WCAG section:** I recomputed all 10 ratios with my own formula, and each is within 0.01 of the doc.
- **Brass reasoning:** the "why Obsidian & Brass" section cites both source files, and its quotes match them word for word. It has no teal, orange or glow wording.
- **Doc 310:** headings, status line and D-IDs are correct.
- **Auth and Studio:** in a fresh context with no credentials, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio sources. `/api/studio-token` returns 401 without a bearer token. `/studio-lab` opens as the demo, so premium auth is not bypassed.
- **Home page:** the header wordmark is brass, `rgb(201, 164, 106)`, and the body background is `rgb(14, 13, 12)` at both sizes.

The real-owner purchased Studio path is blocked here because the backend is unavailable in the cloud.

I filed one Low bug, C-R478-01. DESIGN_SYSTEM.md still says foreground is "94% lightness" and muted "55%" (lines 139–140 and 783/787). The live values are about 89% and 60%, and no checker catches it because they aren't hex values.

`browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. `l57-check.py` reports OK. The next planning has the REGRESSION round due on or after 2026-11-13.
